  <script>
    
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  const loading = document.getElementById('__bundler_loading');
  function setStatus(msg) { if (loading) loading.textContent = msg; }

  const FONT_MIME = /^(font[/]|application[/](x-)?font-|application[/]vnd\.ms-fontobject)/i;
  const MIME_TOKEN = /^[\w.+-]+[/][\w.+-]+$/;
  function toBase64(bytes) {
    let bin = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) {
      bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    }
    return btoa(bin);
  }

  // Error sink persists across replaceWith since it's on window, not the DOM.
  window.addEventListener('error', function(e) {
    // Failed resource loads (CSP-blocked links, scripts, images) fire plain
    // events at the element — warn only; real JS errors carry message/error.
    if (!e.message && !e.error && e.target && e.target !== window) {
      console.warn('[bundle] resource failed to load:',
        e.target.tagName, String(e.target.src || e.target.href || ''));
      return;
    }
    var p = document.body || document.documentElement;
    var d = document.getElementById('__bundler_err') || p.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
    d.id = '__bundler_err';
    d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;background:#2a1215;color:#ff8a80;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #5c2b2e;z-index:99999;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:40vh;overflow:auto';
    d.textContent = (d.textContent ? d.textContent + String.fromCharCode(10) : '') +
      '[bundle] ' + (e.message || e.type) +
      (e.filename ? ' (' + e.filename.slice(0, 60) + ':' + e.lineno + ')' : '');
  }, true);

  try {
    const manifestEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/manifest"]');
    const templateEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/template"]');
    if (!manifestEl || !templateEl) {
      setStatus('Error: missing bundle data');
      console.error('[bundler] Missing script tags — manifestEl:', !!manifestEl, 'templateEl:', !!templateEl);
      return;
    }

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestEl.textContent);
    let template = JSON.parse(templateEl.textContent);

    // Nested page bundles (iframe targets). Each ships ONCE, in the ROOT
    // document's manifest; frame srcs carry an about:blank#<uuid> marker
    // instead of a substitutable uuid. Every document mints the blobs for
    // its OWN frames — from local text at the root, or text obtained from
    // its DIRECT parent over the relay protocol below — so each frame
    // navigation stays same-origin with its initiator and a deduped page
    // loads at any depth on any host, including a file:// download's
    // opaque origins (where a blob minted by one document cannot be
    // navigated to by another).
    const pageOrderEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/page_order"]');
    const pageOrder = pageOrderEl ? JSON.parse(pageOrderEl.textContent) : [];
    const pageSet = new Set(pageOrder);
    const pageTexts = {};

    // ── Nested-page text protocol (parent-chain relay) ──
    // Page bundles ship once, in the ROOT document's manifest. Every
    // document mints the blobs for its OWN frames, obtaining page text
    // through a strict parent-chain relay: a document only ever SENDS to
    // its direct parent (which, for every document the publisher's own
    // runtime minted, is another publisher document) and only ACCEPTS
    // text from that direct parent; requests from below are honored only
    // for the document's own child frames, and the ROOT never sends
    // upward at all. That last rule is load-bearing: the artifact host's
    // frame-ancestors allows claude.ai (and friends) to frame an
    // artifact, so window.top can be a FOREIGN document — a top-addressed
    // protocol would hand page uuids to that ancestor and accept forged
    // "page text" from it, minting attacker HTML as an artifact-origin
    // blob document. The chain never touches the ancestor: requests stop
    // at the root, replies are origin-addressed per hop (never '*' when
    // an origin exists), and both directions are origin-gated (on https
    // a foreign sender's origin can never equal this document's; in
    // opaque contexts — file:// — everything serializes as 'null', where
    // an embedded EXTERNAL frame still fails the gate by carrying its
    // own real origin, and a sandboxed child of such a frame is excluded
    // by the own-child-frames check plus uuid unguessability). Shape is
    // deny-by-default: one request form, one reply form, no error
    // replies.
    // window.origin is the SERIALIZED SECURITY origin ('null' in opaque
    // contexts such as a sandboxed preview iframe) — location.origin is
    // computed from the URL and stays 'https://…' even when the document
    // is sandboxed, which would misgate every opaque chain.
    const OWN_TARGET = /^https?:[/][/]/.test(window.origin || '')
      ? window.origin
      : '*';
    function trustedOrigin(e) {
      if (e.origin === window.origin) return true; // https chains; opaque==opaque
      // file:// trees: Chrome serializes the file document's origin as
      // 'file://' while the blob: documents it mints serialize as 'null',
      // so the two legitimate shapes can never string-match — accept the
      // pair in both directions. https origins never serialize as either,
      // and sender identity (own child frame / direct parent) is checked
      // separately.
      return (
        (e.origin === 'null' &&
          (window.origin === 'file://' ||
            window.location.protocol === 'file:')) ||
        (/^file:/.test(e.origin) && window.origin === 'null')
      );
    }
    // Non-empty only in the root document (nested bundles ship an empty
    // island), so it doubles as the root marker: the root answers from
    // local text and treats a miss as authoritative — never relaying to
    // its (possibly foreign) parent.
    const isPageRoot = pageOrder.length > 0;
    const blobUrls = {};
    const resourceBlobs = {};
    const UUID_SHAPE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
    const pendingFrames = {}; // uuid -> [{el, frag}] awaiting text for own frames
    const pendingRelays = {}; // uuid -> [childWindow] awaiting text to pass down
    function mountPage(el, frag, text) {
      const pageBlob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/html' });
      const u = URL.createObjectURL(pageBlob);
      resourceBlobs[u] = pageBlob;
      el.src = u + frag;
    }
    function deliverPage(uuid, text) {
      const frames = pendingFrames[uuid];
      delete pendingFrames[uuid];
      if (frames) for (const f of frames) mountPage(f.el, f.frag, text);
      const relays = pendingRelays[uuid];
      delete pendingRelays[uuid];
      if (relays) {
        for (const cw of relays) {
          try { cw.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }
        }
      }
    }
    function ownFrameWindows() {
      const out = [];
      for (const f of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))) {
        try { if (f.contentWindow) out.push(f.contentWindow); } catch (err) { /* detached */ }
      }
      return out;
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
      const d = e.data;
      if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || !e.source) return;
      // Origin gate first; the structural checks below (own-child-frames
      // for requests, direct-parent + solicited-uuid for replies, the
      // root's never-relay rule) are what hold in fully opaque chains
      // where origin strings can't discriminate — a sandboxed root's
      // FOREIGN wrapper still fails all three even though both serialize
      // as real-vs-'null' rather than matching.
      if (!trustedOrigin(e)) return;
      if (typeof d.__bundler_need === 'string' && UUID_SHAPE.test(d.__bundler_need)) {
        // Requests are honored only for this document's own child frames.
        if (ownFrameWindows().indexOf(e.source) < 0) return;
        const uuid = d.__bundler_need;
        const text = pageTexts[uuid];
        if (typeof text === 'string') {
          try { e.source.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }
          return;
        }
        if (isPageRoot || window.parent === window) return; // authoritative miss
        const waiting = pendingRelays[uuid];
        if (waiting) {
          if (waiting.indexOf(e.source) < 0) waiting.push(e.source);
          return;
        }
        // Never-answered uuids would otherwise accumulate forever under a
        // request spray; past the cap (far above any real page count) new
        // relays are dropped rather than remembered.
        if (Object.keys(pendingRelays).length >= 128) return;
        pendingRelays[uuid] = [e.source];
        window.parent.postMessage({ __bundler_need: uuid }, OWN_TARGET);
      } else if (
        typeof d.__bundler_page === 'string' &&
        UUID_SHAPE.test(d.__bundler_page) &&
        typeof d.__bundler_text === 'string'
      ) {
        // The shape test is load-bearing beyond tidiness: the solicited
        // check below uses the in operator, which matches prototype keys
        // ('__proto__', 'constructor') — an unshaped key would reach
        // deliverPage and throw, painting the error banner.
        // Text is accepted only from the direct parent — the document
        // that minted this one.
        if (e.source !== window.parent || window.parent === window) return;
        if (!(d.__bundler_page in pendingFrames) && !(d.__bundler_page in pendingRelays)) return;
        deliverPage(d.__bundler_page, d.__bundler_text);
      }
    });

    const uuids = Object.keys(manifest);
    setStatus('Unpacking ' + uuids.length + ' assets...');

    await Promise.all(uuids.map(async (uuid) => {
      const entry = manifest[uuid];
      try {
        const binaryStr = atob(entry.data);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryStr.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binaryStr.length; i++) bytes[i] = binaryStr.charCodeAt(i);

        let finalBytes = bytes;
        if (entry.compressed) {
          if (typeof DecompressionStream !== 'undefined') {
            const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
            const writer = ds.writable.getWriter();
            const reader = ds.readable.getReader();
            writer.write(bytes);
            writer.close();
            const chunks = [];
            let totalLen = 0;
            while (true) {
              const { done, value } = await reader.read();
              if (done) break;
              chunks.push(value);
              totalLen += value.length;
            }
            finalBytes = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
            let offset = 0;
            for (const chunk of chunks) { finalBytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }
          } else {
            console.warn('DecompressionStream not available, asset ' + uuid + ' may not render');
          }
        }

        if (pageSet.has(uuid)) {
          pageTexts[uuid] = new TextDecoder().decode(finalBytes);
          return;
        }
        if (FONT_MIME.test(entry.mime) && MIME_TOKEN.test(entry.mime)) {
          // Strict artifact hosts allow font-src data: but not blob:.
          blobUrls[uuid] = 'data:' + entry.mime + ';base64,' +
            (entry.compressed ? toBase64(finalBytes) : entry.data);
        } else {
          const blob = new Blob([finalBytes], { type: entry.mime });
          blobUrls[uuid] = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          resourceBlobs[blobUrls[uuid]] = blob;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to decode asset ' + uuid + ':', err);
        const blob = new Blob([], { type: entry.mime });
        blobUrls[uuid] = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        resourceBlobs[blobUrls[uuid]] = blob;
      }
    }));

    const extResources = extResEl ? JSON.parse(extResEl.textContent) : [];
    const resourceMap = {};
    for (const entry of extResources) {
      if (blobUrls[entry.uuid]) resourceMap[entry.id] = blobUrls[entry.uuid];
    }

    // Artifact-host CSP (connect-src 'self') refuses fetch() of blob: URLs —
    // consumers read these Blobs directly. Survives the swap like the error sink.
    window.__resourceBlobs = resourceBlobs;

    setStatus('Rendering...');
    // Page uuids have no blob here — they ride inside about:blank#<uuid>
    // frame markers the pass below resolves after the swap.
    for (const uuid of uuids) {
      if (pageSet.has(uuid)) continue;
      template = template.split(uuid).join(blobUrls[uuid]);
    }

    // Strip integrity + crossorigin — blob URLs from a file:// document inherit
    // a null origin, so crossorigin forces a CORS fetch that SRI then rejects.
    // The manifest bytes are ours; SRI protects against CDN compromise, not this.
    template = template.replace(/\s+integrity="[^"]*"/gi, '').replace(/\s+crossorigin="[^"]*"/gi, '');

    const resourceScript = '<script>window.__resources = ' +
      JSON.stringify(resourceMap).replace(/<\//g, '<\\/') +
      ';</' + 'script>';
    // Inject after <head> so the DOCTYPE stays first; prepending the script
    // would push the parser into quirks mode. DOMParser always emits a <head>
    // (synthesizing one if the source HTML omitted it) but may carry
    // attributes through, so match the full opening tag. slice() rather than
    // replace() keeps us clear of $-pattern substitution in resourceScript.
    const headOpen = template.match(/<head[^>]*>/i);
    if (headOpen) {
      const i = headOpen.index + headOpen[0].length;
      template = template.slice(0, i) + resourceScript + template.slice(i);
    }

    // Parse the template and swap the root element. Scripts inserted via
    // DOMParser/replaceWith are inert per spec — re-create each with
    // createElement so they execute, awaiting onload for src scripts to
    // preserve ordering (React before ReactDOM before Babel before text/babel).
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(template, 'text/html');
    document.documentElement.replaceWith(doc.documentElement);

    // Resolve page-frame markers: mint this document's own blob for each
    // framed page — from local text when this is the root, otherwise by
    // asking the direct parent over the relay protocol above. An
    // unanswered request leaves the frame on about:blank, the same
    // degraded state as a refused embed.
    {
      const MARKER = /^about:blank#([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(#.*)?$/;
      const needed = [];
      for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))) {
        const m = MARKER.exec(el.getAttribute('src') || '');
        if (!m) continue;
        const text = pageTexts[m[1]];
        if (typeof text === 'string') {
          mountPage(el, m[2] || '', text);
        } else if (window.parent !== window && !isPageRoot) {
          const had = pendingFrames[m[1]];
          (pendingFrames[m[1]] = had || []).push({ el: el, frag: m[2] || '' });
          if (!had) needed.push(m[1]);
        }
      }
      for (const uuid of needed) {
        window.parent.postMessage({ __bundler_need: uuid }, OWN_TARGET);
      }
    }

    const dead = Array.from(document.scripts);
    for (const old of dead) {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      for (const a of old.attributes) s.setAttribute(a.name, a.value);
      s.textContent = old.textContent;
      // text/babel scripts with a src: read and inline. transformScriptTags
      // does XHR against the src, but blob:null/ from a file:// origin is
      // silently dropped. Inlining makes it a plain inline babel script,
      // which transformScriptTags handles unconditionally.
      if ((s.type === 'text/babel' || s.type === 'text/jsx') && s.src) {
        const pre = resourceBlobs[s.src.split('#')[0]];
        s.textContent = pre ? await pre.text() : await (await fetch(s.src)).text();
        s.removeAttribute('src');
      }
      const p = s.src ? new Promise(function(r) { s.onload = s.onerror = r; }) : null;
      old.replaceWith(s);
      if (p) await p;
    }
    // Babel standalone auto-transforms type=text/babel on DOMContentLoaded,
    // which fired before we swapped the document. Trigger manually if present.
    if (window.Babel && typeof window.Babel.transformScriptTags === 'function') {
      window.Babel.transformScriptTags();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    setStatus('Error unpacking: ' + err.message);
    console.error('Bundle unpack error:', err);
  }
});

  </script>

No webfont: the app runs on the system UI stack and the system mono, which is\n   why there is no @font-face anywhere in this system. */\n:root {\n  /* Upstream (App.css) spells the stack in full:\n       -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif\n     The Linux-only names are dropped from the token so this system does not advertise webfonts\n     it has no binaries for. Rendering is identical on macOS and Windows; on Linux the generic\n     sans-serif resolves to the same faces. */\n  --font-ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; /* @kind font */\n  --rs-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; /* @kind font */\n  --font-mono: var(--rs-mono);\n\n  --text-h1: 1.75rem;   /* page title */\n  --text-h1-login: 2.5rem;\n  --text-h2: 1.125rem;\n  --text-h3: 1rem;\n  --text-lg: 1.25rem;   /* the price, the one number a page exists to show */\n  --text-base: 1rem;\n  --text-ui: 0.875rem;  /* the app's working size: labels, buttons, table cells */\n  --text-nav: 0.9rem;\n  --text-sm: 0.8125rem; /* monospaced values, hints */\n  --text-xs: 0.75rem;   /* badges, timestamps, detail lines */\n  --text-mono-block: 0.78rem;\n  --text-badge: 0.7rem;\n\n  --leading-heading: 1.25;\n  --leading-ui: 1.5;\n  --leading-prose: 1.6;\n  --leading-notice: 1.45;\n\n  --weight-regular: 400;\n  --weight-medium: 500;\n  --weight-semibold: 600;\n  --weight-bold: 700;\n\n  --tracking-caps: 0.05em;\n  --measure-prose: 62ch;\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* Spacing. The app's steps are rem quarters with two thirds-steps (0.375, 0.625, 0.875)\n   that appear often enough to be tokens rather than accidents. */\n:root {\n  --space-0-5: 0.125rem;\n  --space-1: 0.25rem;\n  --space-1-5: 0.375rem;\n  --space-2: 0.5rem;\n  --space-2-5: 0.625rem;\n  --space-3: 0.75rem;\n  --space-3-5: 0.875rem;\n  --space-4: 1rem;\n  --space-5: 1.25rem;\n  --space-6: 1.5rem;\n  --space-7: 1.75rem;\n  --space-8: 2rem;\n  --space-10: 2.5rem;\n\n  /* Measures. Each one is a page's column width in the app. */\n  --measure-app: 1200px;\n  --measure-form: 760px;\n  --measure-help: 760px;\n  --measure-wizard: 680px;\n  --measure-home: 680px;\n  --measure-login: 400px;\n  --measure-modal: 440px;\n  --measure-modal-wide: 700px;\n\n  --grid-server-min: 320px;\n  --grid-pack-min: 260px;\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* Borders and radii. There are no shadows in this system — a surface is told apart from\n   the page by a 1px hairline and one step of lightness, never by a drop shadow. */\n:root {\n  --rs-radius: 6px;      /* cards, buttons, inputs, notices */\n  --radius-sm: 3px;      /* inline code */\n  --radius-inset: 4px;   /* a box inside a card: log, key lines, provisioning step */\n  --radius-tile-lg: 10px;/* the large pack tile */\n  --radius-pill: 9999px; /* status pills, chips, badges */\n  --border-width: 1px;\n  --border-accent-width: 2px; /* the active tab underline, the callout rule */\n  --focus-ring: 2px solid var(--rs-link);\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* Motion. Two durations and two keyframes, and that is the whole vocabulary: colour and\n   border transitions at 0.15s, a pulse for \"this is happening now\", a spinner for a wait.\n   Nothing slides, bounces, or scales. */\n:root {\n  --dur-fast: 0.15s; /* @kind other */\n  --ease-default: ease; /* @kind other */\n  --transition-interactive: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; /* @kind other */\n  --transition-nav: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; /* @kind other */\n  --dur-pulse: 1.5s; /* @kind other */\n  --dur-spin: 1s; /* @kind other */\n}\n\n@keyframes rs-pulse {\n  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }\n  50% { opacity: 0.4; }\n}\n\n@keyframes rs-spin {\n  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<script Blue is the accent here; the beam replaces it under the skin.<\u002Fp>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Type, and the rule about caps<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">There is a webfont now: Rocky Surf Regular, served from <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">/fonts/<\u002Fcode>, on headings and subheadings only — at body size the face is hard to read, so running text, tables, nav, fields and buttons stay on the system stack. They never carry a sentence.<\u002Fstrong> A paragraph in letterspaced caps is unreadable, and it turns <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">sshAllowedCidr<\u002Fcode> into SSHALLOWEDCIDR.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">Cut: <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">dt<\u002Fcode>, <code 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">Opted back out, because they are prose: <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">.price-note<\u002Fcode>, the provider-error detail, a step's notice, and a repo chip — a URL in caps is unreadable, so chips are lowercase mono at 400.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n    <p style=\"margin:1rem 0 0;max-width:62ch;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\">Line heights: 1.25 on headings, 1.5 in the app, 1.6 in prose, 1.45 in a notice. Under the base skin h1 is 1.75rem with no tracking and h2 is a plain 1.125rem in <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">#f0f6fc<\u002Fcode> — no caps anywhere except the install preview's section labels.<\u002Fp>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Light, edges and space<\u002Fh2>\n    <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1rem\">\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Illumination<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0 0 0.75rem;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">The painting has one light in it, off to the left, and everything is described by how far it sits from that light. The page is four layers: a near glow at the source, the beam's throw, a long diagonal falloff, then unlit ground — fixed, so it does not scroll.<\u002Fp>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Every surface repeats it at 148°: cream at 0.045 to 0.008, then black at 0.12. A card that ignores the room's light reads as a sticker on top of it. The base skin has no gradients at all.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Corners<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0 0 0.75rem;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">An engraved plate has corners. <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">--rs-radius: 0<\u002Fcode> covers most of it; the skin then squares the two dozen places App.css hardcodes a radius — badges, chips, pack marks, log blocks, dropzones, inline code.<\u002Fp>\n        <div style=\"display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center\">\n          <span style=\"padding:0.25rem 0.5rem;border:1px solid #3fb950;color:#3fb950;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.12em;font-size:0.62rem;font-weight:600\">Running<\u002Fspan>\n          <span style=\"padding:0.125rem 0.5rem;border:1px solid rgba(252,245,232,0.2);color:#8a8494;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:500\">community<\u002Fspan>\n          <span style=\"width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;background:#316dca;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,245,232,0.2);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem\">GT<\u002Fspan>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.75rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Buttons are the exception: they keep an explicit 6px. Pack marks gain an inset cream hairline so a PNG sits in a frame rather than floating.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Measure and padding<\u002Fdiv>\n        <dl 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">rem quarters, with 0.375 / 0.625 / 0.875 as real steps. No sidebar anywhere; one centred column. Below 768px everything collapses to one column and page padding drops to 1.25rem.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Motion, and shadows<\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">\n          <span style=\"width:32px;height:32px;border:3px solid #3c3448;border-top-color:#e8c37a;border-radius:50%;animation:rs-spin 1s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0\"><\u002Fspan>\n          <span style=\"width:12px;height:12px;background:#e3b341;animation:rs-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;flex-shrink:0\"><\u002Fspan>\n          <span style=\"font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\"><code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">rs-spin<\u002Fcode> 1s for a wait; <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">rs-pulse<\u002Fcode> 1.5s for \"happening now\". Nothing slides, scales, fades in or bounces.<\u002Fspan>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Transitions are 0.15s ease on background and border colour, plus 0.08s on a button's transform and shadow. The base system has no shadows at all; this skin adds them in exactly two places — the pack popup, which hangs over a grid, and every control.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">The header<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">One fixed element, and the product's one licence with imagery: the painting's cloud band runs the width of the bar, screened so the night drops to nothing and masked to transparent by 94% across. Screen is what removes the brand plate's rectangle, not the mask. Under this skin the band drops to 0.5 because the ground is already carrying a cream highlight, and the bar's bottom rule is the beam at 30% rather than a grey hairline.<\u002Fp>\n    <div <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n    <p style=\"margin:0;max-width:62ch;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\">The header background must stay opaque — screen composites against whatever is behind it, so a <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">backdrop-filter<\u002Fcode> here breaks it. The band is dropped below 768px, where the nav wraps and the fade would land under the links. The mark must stay one raster with a dark ground: swap in a transparent PNG or an SVG and the blend, the contrast lift and the mask all come off. If this treatment spreads past this one bar, the flat-background rule is gone rather than bent.<\u002Fp>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Buttons<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">Dimensional, not flat-cut: a top highlight inside, a hairline and a 4px drop below, a 2px bottom border, and a real press. style=\"margin:0\">Creates something new — New server, New tool. Carries <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">.new-action<\u002Fcode> alongside <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">.primary<\u002Fcode>, so the base skin still sees a primary and the later rule wins here.<\u002Fdd>\n        <dt style=\"color:#7ee08f;white-space:nowrap;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;font-size:0.68rem;align-self:center\">Green<\u002Fdt><dd style=\"margin:0\">Acts on a resource that already exists — Start, Save.<\u002Fdd>\n        <dt style=\"color:#e3b341;white-space:nowrap;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;font-size:0.68rem;align-self:center\">Yellow<\u002Fdt><dd style=\"margin:0\">Reversible. The skin only switches off the dots, the rail and the left padding they needed.<\u002Fp>\n          <p style=\"margin:0 0 0.875rem;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">Steps behind the beam are solid at 0.7 opacity, the current one is 1.4px and pulsing, everything ahead is dashed at 0.2. Nothing is filled except the one thing currently true. A step a bootstrap died on turns red and the beam stops there.<\u002Fp>\n          <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Beacon measures its rows rather than assuming 30px each: the one-line reason under an active step makes that row taller, and a beam drawn against fixed rows would cross the wrong labels the moment one grew. Step words come from <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">lib/format<\u002Fcode>, never a second copy of the list, so two screens cannot disagree about what a step is called.<\u002Fp>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">The parts that are built but not mounted<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">These seven live in <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">etched.tsx<\u002Fcode> and no page imports them. Drawn here at their real geometry so the gap between what exists and what ships is visible. Each needs <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">EtchedDefs<\u002Fcode> mounted once per page for its hatch — without it the strokes Uptime has no ceiling, so it must not be drawn as a gauge — a bar or a curve implies an axis that does not exist. It sits beside the value, never instead of it, and past 18 hours the count stops growing while the number stays the fact.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n\n      <div an ellipse of width |1 − 2f|, so the disc never reads as a pie slice, and its mask id comes from <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem Waterline is only for a quantity whose ceiling is named beside it — spend against the cap is the only one in this product. It deliberately never appears on a server card: there is no room to state the cap there, and a level without its ceiling is decoration.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem\">Swell — the divider<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0 0 0.75rem;font-size:0.875rem;color:#cbc5cf\">Connection<\u002Fp>\n        <svg width=\"100%\" height=\"9\" sc-camel-view-box=\"0 0 400 9\" sc-camel-preserve-aspect-ratio=\"none\" aria-hidden=\"true\" style=\"display:block;color:#e8c37a;opacity:0.4\"><path d=\"M0 5 q 12.5 -4 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0 t 25 0\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"0.9\"><\u002Fpath><\u002Fsvg>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.75rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">The same separation a 1px rule gives, said in the illustration's hand. style=\"margin:0;text-align:right;font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.8125rem\">$21.40<\u002Fdd>\n        <\u002Fdl>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.875rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">A rule, an inset margin, and registration ticks at the corners, instead of a 6px radius. <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">lit<\u002Fcode> is reserved for state that is genuinely live: every plate lit is no plate lit. It takes <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">as<\u002Fcode> and forwards attributes, so it can be the server card itself and keep <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">data-status<\u002Fcode> where the stylesheet and the tests read it.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n    <p style=\"margin:1rem 0 0;max-width:62ch;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\">Two honest caveats from the source: the line art is drawn geometry, not illustration — competent and consistent, and no substitute for an engraver's hand, with Lamp and Shore in particular deserving drawn assets if this becomes the product's face.<\u002Fp>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Notices — hatched, not filled<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">Every notice keeps its meaning and loses its fill: a 45° repeating hatch in the accent at 14%, over the night ground. Four registers, and picking the wrong one tells the operator something untrue.<\u002Fp>\n    <div style=\"display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem\">\n      <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(210,153,34,0.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);border:1px solid #d29922;padding:0.75rem 1rem;color:#d29922;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.45\">\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.5rem\"><span style=\"font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45\">⚠<\u002Fspan><span>The address changed: <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem;color:#f85149;text-decoration:line-through\">54.174.12.9<\u002Fcode> <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem;color:#56d364;font-weight:600\">3.221.8.41<\u002Fcode>. Your saved SSH command points at the old one.<\u002Fspan><\u002Fdiv>\n        <button style=\"background:transparent;border:none;color:inherit;font-size:1.25rem;cursor:pointer;padding:0 0.25rem;line-height:1;opacity:0.8;font-family:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;box-shadow:none\">×<\u002Fbutton>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(210,153,34,0.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);border:1px solid #e8c37a;padding:0.75rem 1rem;color:#e8c37a;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.45\">\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.5rem\"><span style=\"font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45\">●<\u002Fspan><span>Two servers were last seen more than a day ago. The dashboard shows the record Rocky Surf holds, not a live reading from your cloud account.<\u002Fspan><\u002Fdiv>\n        <button style=\"background:transparent;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:6px;color:inherit;font-size:0.8125rem;padding:0.25rem 0.6rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;font-weight:700\">Refresh<\u002Fbutton>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.6rem;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(248,81,73,0.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);border:1px solid #f85149;padding:0.75rem 1rem;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.45\">\n        <span style=\"font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45;color:#f8837d\">●<\u002Fspan>\n        <div><div><strong style=\"color:#fcf5e8\">dev-box has been running for 6 days.<\u002Fstrong> You are billed for its compute for every hour of that.<\u002Fdiv><p style=\"margin:0.4rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494;opacity:0.8\">Stop it and the disk is kept, so you can start it again later. No dismiss button, so no room made for one.<\u002Fp><\u002Fdiv>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(210,153,34,0.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:0.75rem 1rem;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.45\">This box is gone; what follows is the record. A terminated server is not a problem to fix, so it is neither yellow nor red — dressing history in a warning colour tells everyone who reads their own history that something went wrong.<\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n    <p style=\"margin:1rem 0 0;max-width:62ch;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\">Blue joined the family for the standing informational notice — under this skin the beam takes blue's place, so it reads gold. The bootstrap report uses the same hatch at a lower alpha, because it is long and already inside a card. Under the base skin all of these are flat washes: the accent at 20% (or 9% for the report), bordered in the accent at full strength.<\u002Fp>\n    <p style=\"margin:0.625rem 0 0;max-width:62ch;font-size:0.8125rem;color:#8a8494\">Core's message is passed through verbatim: \"server is still stopping; try again in a moment\" beats \"Could not stop dev-box\", because a UI that rewrites an error throws away the remedy. A provider's refusal keeps the red card but reads its headline in normal text — red on red is unreadable — with the raw diagnostic in a monospace block underneath, capped at 16rem and scrolling, and that block is explicitly opted out of caps.<\u002Fp>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Controls and surfaces<\u002Fh2>\n    <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:1rem\">\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.875rem\">Tabs<\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"display:flex;gap:0.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid #3c3448;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">\n          <button style=\"background:none;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid #e8c37a;margin-bottom:-1px;padding:0.5rem The dot marks unsaved work on a tab you are not looking at; it is decoration, with the sentence beside it in <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">.sr-only<\u002Fcode>.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.875rem\">Field<\u002Fdiv>\n        <label style=\"display:block;color:#fcf5e8;font-weight:600;font-size:0.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-bottom:0.375rem\">Name<\u002Flabel>\n        <input type=\"text\" placeholder=\"dev-box\" style=\"background:#0a0910;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:0.625rem 0.75rem;color:#cbc5cf;font-size:0.875rem;font-family:inherit;width:100%\">\n        <p style=\"margin:0.5rem 0 0;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.5;max-width:62ch;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal\">What a setting is for, under its label and above its control. A chip names a repository, and a URL in caps is unreadable, so chips stay lowercase mono; a picked one goes flat and disabled rather than disappearing, so the list keeps its shape.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.875rem\">Dashed edges, and the dropzone<\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"padding:0.75rem 0.875rem;border:1px dashed #3c3448;margin-bottom:0.75rem\"><p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem\">Use this type every time.<\u002Fp><\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;min-height:5rem;border:1px dashed #3c3448;color:#8a8494;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;padding:1rem;font-size:0.875rem\" style-hover=\"border-color:#e8c37a;color:#cbc5cf\">Drop a pack YAML here, or click to choose one<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.875rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Two dashed edges in the app, both meaning \"not a choice in the list beside it\". The dropzone's input stays in the DOM and keyboard-reachable — only its own box is hidden — so click and drag are one control, not two paths.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div No icon library, no icon font, no emoji.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.875rem\">Pack marks<\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap\">\n          <img src=\"7317c904-6968-4b0c-b635-af64739f6c54\" alt=\"\" style=\"width:3.5rem;height:3.5rem;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,245,232,0.2)\">\n          <img src=\"dd3e543c-2edc-400f-a70a-fde1a3936cb2\" alt=\"\" style=\"width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,245,232,0.2)\">\n          <img src=\"10255e43-bd5e-4bfc-81f4-569bd08081dc\" alt=\"\" style=\"width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,245,232,0.2)\">\n          <span style=\"display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;background:#8256d0;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,245,232,0.2)\">DH<\u002Fspan>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.875rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">3.5rem on a card, where the mark is the card's identity; 2.5rem in a list of rows, where it sits beside a name. The monogram fallback is the first letters of the first two words, on one of six accents — orange, blue, green, purple, red, slate — chosen by a stable hash of the pack id. Never <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">Math.random<\u002Fcode>, never the list index: a pack must look the same on every reload.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.25rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) for the Standard M family is 8; this type needs 8 more.<\u002Fspan><\u002Fsc-raw-td><\u002Fsc-raw-tr>\n          <\u002Fsc-raw-tbody>\n        <\u002Fsc-raw-table>\n        <p style=\"margin:0.875rem 0 0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8494\">Column headers are cut labels; the caption is prose and stays prose. Values never wrap; the one cell that must is a provider's reason, because that is a sentence rather than a unit. Why a row cannot be bought is text, not a banner — a page-level notice's padding and border leak out of a table cell.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n\n  <sc-if value=\"{{ showVoice }}\" hint-placeholder-val=\"{{ true }}\">\n  <section style=\"margin-bottom:3rem\">\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Voice<\u002Fh2>\n    <p style=\"margin:0 0 1.25rem;max-width:62ch;color:#8a8494;font-size:0.875rem\">A peer who has already made the mistake. The README opens with a joke and then never jokes again; product copy is flat, specific, and slightly grim about money and credentials.<\u002Fp>\n    <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:0.75rem\">\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">Second person, always<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">\"Your AWS account, your Hetzner project.\" \"Rocky Surf holds the credential and calls the API. The resources and the bill are yours.\" Never \"we\", never \"users\".<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">State the consequence<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">Stop: \"The disk is kept, so you can start it again later. You are not billed for a stopped instance's compute.\" Terminate: \"This destroys the server and its disk. It cannot be undone.\" Never \"Are you sure?\".<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">Say what it will not do<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">\"Rocky Surf will not show it to you.\" \"There is no way to add a token to a running box.\" Refusals are features here and are written as such.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">Numbers carry their caveat<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">Every cost is followed by \"Estimate. Rounds down: uptime accrues on a timer, so a running server has cost slightly more than shown.\" A missing value is an em dash with the reason in its title, never a zero.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">Sentence case under the caps<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">The skin cuts labels in caps; the words themselves are still sentence case. The only real uppercase is <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">BYOC<\u002Fcode>, <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">SSH<\u002Fcode>, <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">MCP<\u002Fcode>, <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">YAML<\u002Fcode>. Anything typed or copied is lowercase mono: <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">~/.rockysurf<\u002Fcode>.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <h3 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:1rem;color:#fcf5e8;margin:0 0 0.5rem\">Empty and pending states<\u002Fh3>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.6\">A fact plus one action. \"No servers yet. Create one to get started.\" \"Stopping…\" — the ellipsis is the spinner. And no emoji: not one, anywhere in the source.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n  <\u002Fsc-if>\n\n  <sc-if value=\"{{ showCoverage }}\" hint-placeholder-val=\"{{ true }}\">\n  <section>\n    <h2 style=\"font-family:'Rocky Surf',var(--font-ui);font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#e8c37a;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 0.75rem\">Coverage<\u002Fh2>\n    <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:0.75rem\">\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Read in full<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\"><code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">App.css<\u002Fcode> (2,890 lines), <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">etched.css<\u002Fcode> (345), <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">components/etched.tsx<\u002Fcode>, <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">index.html<\u002Fcode>, <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">App.tsx<\u002Fcode>. Part mounts were checked by searching the whole of <code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">packages/web/src<\u002Fcode>.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Not opened<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">The page components themselves — Settings (78KB), Create (90KB), Packs (59KB), Help, Costs, ServerDetail, Dashboard. Every class name they use appears in the stylesheets, so their treatments are represented; their screens are not recreated field-for-field, and their copy is quoted from the stylesheet comments rather than from the JSX.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Stale elsewhere<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\">The bound design system still states \"no webfont\" and \"no gradients, no shadows, one theme\" as absolutes, and treats the etched skin as an opt-in exploration. All four are now out of date against the source. There is still no slide template, because the repo has none.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n      <div style=\"background:#171420;border:1px solid #3c3448;padding:1.1rem;background-image:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(252,245,232,0.045) 0%,rgba(252,245,232,0.008) 46%,rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 100%)\">\n        <div style=\"font-size:0.68rem;color:#8a8494;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem\">Read the source anyway<\u002Fdiv>\n        <p style=\"margin:0;font-size:0.8125rem;line-height:1.6;color:#cbc5cf\"><code style=\"font-family:var(--rs-mono);font-size:0.85em;background:#221d2c;padding:0.125rem 0.375rem\">App.css<\u002Fcode> carries a comment on nearly every rule explaining why the value is what it is, and the components carry long doc comments about what the UI refuses to do. That reasoning is the real design system, and it is longer than this page.<\u002Fp>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fsection>\n  <\u002Fsc-if>\n\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<\u002Fx-dc>\n<script type=\"text/x-dc\" data-dc-script=\"\" data-props=\"{&quot;showVoice&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:true,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;Sections&quot;},&quot;showCoverage&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:true,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;Sections&quot;}}\">\nclass Component extends DCLogic {\n  renderVals() {\n    return {\n      showVoice: this.props.showVoice ?? true,\n      showCoverage: this.props.showCoverage ?? true,\n    };\n  }\n}\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"
  </script>
</body>
</html>
